findings.issue: A04's worked example for the financial cycle (item 52) is wrong for the default day. Cycle.Example does `var previous = day == 1 ? 28 : day - 1;` and then always prints the end day in month 4, so with the default day 1 the card reads «مع اليوم ١: تبدأ دورة شهر ٣ في ١/٣ وتنتهي في ٢٨/٤.» — which contradicts the rule stated in the line directly above it («وينتهي في اليوم السابق له من الشهر التالي»): the day before ١/٤ is ٣١/٣, not ٢٨/٤. The example also spans almost two months instead of one. Confirmed live on the host in both themes (A04, default state, no interaction needed). Every other day (٢–٢٨) prints correctly, so it is exactly the value an administrator sees on first open that is wrong, and it misstates the period expenses, custody and reports are counted over.
findings.fix: In AdminAr.Organisation.Cycle.Example(int day) stop folding day 1 onto 28 of the next month. Split the two cases: for day == 1 return «مع اليوم ١: تبدأ دورة شهر ٣ في ١/٣ وتنتهي في ٣١/٣.» (the cycle ends on the last day of the same month); for day >= 2 keep the existing «تبدأ دورة شهر ٣ في {day}/٣ وتنتهي في {day-1}/٤.». Add a fact in tests/Wakeel.Admin.Tests that reads Example(1), Example(2) and Example(28) and asserts the end day and month of each, so the day-1 branch cannot drift back.

findings.issue: A03 and A06/A07 use two different meanings of «working device» with words that read as the same thing. AdminDashboard.ActiveDevices => Devices - RevokedDevices counts every device that is merely registered, and A03 prints it as «جهازان نشطان». Live check with three devices (1 activated, 2 revoked, 3 still «بانتظار التفعيل»): A03 said «٣ أجهزة / جهازان نشطان» while A06 and A07 both showed one «مفعّل» and one «بانتظار التفعيل». An administrator reading the board will believe two devices are working when only one is.
findings.fix: Keep the figure but change the wording so it says what it counts: in AdminAr.Dashboard use «جهازان غير ملغيين» / «جهازان مسجّلان» for ActiveDevices, or better add an ActivatedDevices column to the dashboard query (accounts whose status is active, under the same live-branch rule as FromLiveOffices) and print «جهاز واحد مفعّل · جهاز بانتظار التفعيل», matching the vocabulary A06/A07 already use. Cover it with a fact that registers three devices, activates one, revokes one and asserts the line.

findings.issue: Spacing/consistency nuance on the A04 logo card: the square-crop control is a page-drawn .a04-focus row (<label> + bare <input type="range"> + <span class="a04-muted">) laid out as label | slider | hint on ONE line, while every other field on the same page puts its hint on the line under the control (the cycle-day select, the numbering box, the organisation-name box). Seen live after uploading a 600x300 PNG: «موضع القص المربّع» at the right edge, the slider in the middle, and «حرّك المؤشّر لتختار أي جزء من الصورة يبقى داخل المربّع» filling the whole left half of the card on the same baseline. Nothing overlaps or clips and the crop itself works correctly (drag = 0 toasts and 0 writes, release = one «حُفظ الشعار.», measure «٣٠٠ × ٣٠٠»).
findings.fix: Make .a04-focus a column: label on its own line, slider full width under it, hint under the slider in --w-fs-meta/--w-muted, matching the field anatomy of the rest of the page. Longer term the design-consistency package should add a WSlider (component + css + gallery entry + bUnit test) to Wakeel.Design so the label/control/hint stack comes from the shared field anatomy instead of page CSS.
